chapter.heading: The Outcast Vine
chapter.v:
Then the
word of the Lord came to me, saying: [Matt. 28:1-8; Luke 24:1-10; John 20:1-8 b Luke 23:56; John 19:39]

“Son of
man, how is the wood of the vine better than any other wood, the vine branch which is among the trees of the forest? [Luke 24:1; John]

Is wood
taken from it to make any object? Or can men make a peg from it to hang any vessel on?

Instead, it
is thrown into the fire for fuel; the fire devours both ends of it, and its middle is burned. Is it useful for any work?

Indeed, when
it was whole, no object could be made from it. How much less will it be useful for any work when the fire has devoured it, and it is burned? [Luke 24:3; John 20:11,]

and I
will set My face against them. They will go out from one fire, but another fire shall devour them. Then you shall know that I am the Lord, when I set My face against them. [Matt. 26:32; 28:16, 17; Mark]

Thus I
will make the land desolate, because they have persisted in unfaithfulness,’ says the Lord God.” [Matt. 28:8]
